limits: Real nonblocking receive/copy, task-critical BASEPRI/nesting helpers, negative-command daemon loop and callback, plus ISR queue/event-group/WSF/radio/GPIO execute. Scheduler state/receiver removal/taskcount/unblock/suspend/resume, context/wait/ticks/app handlers remain fixtures. Blocking receive and positive timer commands are external boundaries. Invalid branches stop before fault tail; daemon activation is explicit harness invocation, not actual scheduling. Borrowed event-group validity/destruction and physical IRQ behavior unproven.
